PersonalTrainer.title: PersonalTrainer
PersonalTrainer.description: Represents a personal trainer who uses the ElevateFit platform to manage students and workouts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PersonalTrainer entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the personal trainer.

lastName.description: The last name of the personal trainer.

email.description: The email address of the personal trainer, used for communication.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the trainer account was created.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student client managed by a personal trainer on the ElevateFit platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

personalTrainerId.description: Reference to the PersonalTrainer managing this student.

firstName.description: The first name of the student.

lastName.description: The last name of the student.

email.description: The email address of the student, used for communication.

currentWeightKg.description: The current weight of the student in kilograms.

goals.description: A description of the student's fitness goals.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the student profile was created.
